messages:
maria: Heads up — planning a deploy for routing + observability tweaks at 15:30 PT (in ~20m). Non-incident canary. I'll own the deploy.
jon: I'm on watch for smoke. Will validate traces, latency, and error-rate.
kevin: I pushed the dashboard updates (PR link) — https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/abcd-routing-obsv. Will create a 5m p95 panel for quick checks.
meera: Alert proposal: new rule (canary-only) — p95_latency_high if p95(route_latency_seconds) > 300ms for 5m. Rollback if p95 > 400ms for 5m or errors/sec > 2x baseline.
kevin: Copy. I'll stage the alert as canary-only toggle and annotate the dashboard. PR #4321 merged to canary branch.
maria: Quick smoke checklist (short):
- sanity request to /v1/route -> 200
- p95 < 300ms on canary
- traces show no spike in root span duration
- no increase in error 5xx or timeouts
jon: Got it. I'll run the smoke steps and tail logs.
kevin: Adding ephemeral panel: query = histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(route_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))
meera: Rollback plan: immediate revert of deploy (promote previous revision) + revert alert threshold change. Ping @oncall if any criteria met.
maria: Starting canary now (deploy-bot kicked off).
deploy-bot: Canary started by maria — routing-v2 — 5% traffic -> https://deploys.internal/redwood/1930006789
jon: Observability smoke: quick request path OK, traces look normal, no new errors in tail. p95 ~ 210ms. :thumbsup:
kevin: Dashboard shows canary p95 at ~220ms, panel annotated with deploy=1930006789. Alerts are in canary-only mode so won't fire on prod.
meera: Monitoring for 10m window. If p95 >= 400ms for 5m or errors > 2x baseline, we roll back.
maria: Canary healthy at 10m. Promoting to 50%.
deploy-bot: Promotion complete — 50% traffic now.
jon: Secondary smoke after promotion: all good. No error increase.
kevin: Creating a short-lived alert suppression rule for false positives during promotion. Created annotation in Grafana.
maria: Rolling to 100% in 5m. If anything pops, follow rollback plan.
meera: Noted. I'll stay on watch for the next 15m.
deploy-bot: Promotion complete — 100% traffic.
jon: Final checks green across dashboards and traces.
kevin: Dashboards updated, ephemeral p95 panel removed after validation. Will open a follow-up doc with the exact threshold changes.
maria: Thanks everyone — smooth deploy. Filing a short release note and closing the rollout ticket. :tada:
